g.text: Colemak-DH · Bilateral Home-Row Mods · Semantic F13–F24 Protocol · 60 Positions · 2x Rotary Encoders
Plain QWERTY, no HRMs. Tap REC to exit.
Left side: NAV LT5 / ADJUST LT5
Right side: NUM RT5 / ADJUST RT5
Right BOOT requires split link. Use
Default / NAV: Page Down / Page Up
MOUSE layer: Volume Down / Vol Up
Default / NAV: Volume Down / Vol Up
MOUSE layer: Page Down / Page Up
Requires active Karabiner or AHK bridge.
